scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes appropriations for a competitive grant program ($200,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2026-2030), FAA research ($35,000,000 annually for fiscal years 2026-2030), and Department of Energy research (such sums as may be necessary). These provisions directly increase government spending.

The bill's primary goal is to reduce greenhouse gas emissions from aviation by promoting sustainable aviation fuel through mandates, research, and tax credits. This directly aims to enhance environmental protection by mitigating climate change impacts.
